reference_coordinate_frame: Ego-Vehicle Coordinate System at Camera Keyframe Timestamp (V_ego)
temporal_strategy_explanation: Because reference sample ca9a282c... is at the start of scene-0061 (sample[0], prev=''), consecutive sweeps 1 and 2 are forward-in-time subsequent sweeps (+75.03 ms, +150.21 ms) collected via sample_data['next'] and transformed into the reference keyframe ego frame.

nuScenes_devkit_filters_in_from_file.invalid_states_filter: kept [0] (0x00=valid cluster; discards low RCS, near-field artefacts, mirrors, harmonics)
nuScenes_devkit_filters_in_from_file.dynprop_states_filter: kept range(7) [0..6] (moving, stationary, oncoming, etc.; discards 7=stopped)
nuScenes_devkit_filters_in_from_file.ambig_states_filter: kept [3] (unambiguous Doppler solution only; discards ambiguous/invalid solutions)

applied_filtering.downstream_custom_filters: none (all 216 retained returns preserved without spatial or velocity truncation)

velocity_interpretation.interpretation: Scalar ego-compensated radial Doppler velocity along the sensor line-of-sight.
velocity_interpretation.explicit_caution: vx_comp and vy_comp do NOT constitute a complete 2D object velocity vector. No 2D travel direction or trajectory is claimed.

documented_limitations: Radial velocity measures 1D line-of-sight closing rate; it does not provide complete 2D or 3D object velocity vectors.
Ego-motion compensation transforms coordinate frames, but does not track or associate returns between sweeps as specific physical objects.
Radar returns are physically sparse reflections; multipath or ghost returns can occur.
No collision prediction, crash probability, or hazard thresholds are claimed.
